title: Gym Trainer
description: A training week with an animated coach who shows you how to do it right. Every exercise plays as one continuous demonstration in two parts: setup, which is how you stand and pick the weight up, and train, which is the working posture. No rep counters and no countdowns — your sets, reps, load and the exact travel of every rep are written out, and you tap Done when you have finished. Finish a day and that date is ticked on your calendar.
